title: DecisionTrace
description: The canonical explainability authority contract. Emitted by the Strategy Evaluation Engine (SEE) for every STRATEGY_EVALUATED event. Provides the certified rationale for every trading decision. The UI must render this schema's fields as the sole source of decision explanation — it must never reconstruct, narrate, or synthesize decision rationale from raw events. This schema directly replaces the groupAndNarrateEvents() and compareNarrativeBlocks() client-side functions in the prototype UI.

trace_id.description: Unique identifier for this decision trace.

emitted_at_ns.description: Nanosecond timestamp at which the SEE emitted this trace.

anchor_sequence_id.description: The sequence_id of the STRATEGY_EVALUATED AuthoritativeEvent this trace explains. One-to-one relationship — every STRATEGY_EVALUATED event has exactly one DecisionTrace.

strategy_id.description: The strategy instance that produced this decision.

decision.description: The certified decision output. All fields are backend-computed. The UI verdict and confidence displays in StrategyInspector.js (lines 246-273) must be replaced by these fields.

action.description: The certified trading action. Backend-computed — UI must not infer action from signal values.

symbol.description: The instrument symbol this decision concerns.

quantity.description: Optional. Order quantity. Present for BUY, SELL, CLOSE actions.

price_target.description: Optional. Target execution price. Present when the strategy specifies a limit.

confidence.description: Backend-certified confidence score (0.0–1.0). Replaces client-side confidence computation in StrategyInspector.js:246-273.

verdict.description: Backend-certified verdict classification. Replaces client-side verdict derivation in StrategyInspector.js:246-273.

signal_inputs.description: Ordered array of signal inputs evaluated to produce this decision. Backend-certified — UI must not recompute signal contributions.

normalized_value.description: Signal value normalized to [-1, 1] by the backend.

weight.description: Backend-assigned signal weight for this strategy configuration.

contribution.description: Backend-computed weighted contribution of this signal to the final decision score.

source_sequence_id.description: Optional. The sequence_id of the SIGNAL_RECEIVED event that produced this value. Establishes causal lineage.

narrative_blocks.description: Ordered array of backend-emitted narrative blocks. This is the authoritative replacement for groupAndNarrateEvents() in StrategyInspector.js. The UI renders these blocks in order — it must not group, reorder, or synthesize narrative independently.

block_id.description: Unique identifier for this narrative block.

group.description: Backend-assigned narrative group. Replaces client-side grouping logic in groupAndNarrateEvents().

sequence_id.description: The AuthoritativeEvent sequence_id this block narrates.

narrative.description: Backend-emitted narrative text. UI renders verbatim — never paraphrases or reformats.

block_type.description: Block type classification. DIVERGENCE_MARKER replaces client-side divergence detection in compareNarrativeBlocks().

parent_block_id.description: Optional. Present for DERIVED and CAUSAL_LINK blocks. Backend-certified parent relationship — UI must not derive ancestry.

divergence_score.description: Optional. Present for DIVERGENCE_MARKER blocks. Backend-computed divergence score — replaces compareNarrativeBlocks() client-side computation.

causal_ancestry.description: Ordered array of sequence_ids representing the certified causal ancestry chain for this decision. Backend-certified — UI causal chain highlighting must use this field, never derive ancestry from event patterns.

ga_lineage.description: Optional. Present when this decision was produced by a GA-optimized strategy. Provides certified GA lineage.

trace_signature.description: SHA-256 hex digest of (trace_id + anchor_sequence_id + strategy_id + decision.action + decision.verdict). Enables Law One audit for all explainability surfaces.
